# org_link_tool

> Place an agent in the organization structure: set its manager, its reports, or its escalation contact.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `organization` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=org_link_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Place an agent in the organization structure: set its manager, its reports, or its
escalation contact.

USE THIS WHEN:
- You have just created an agent and need to say who it reports to.
- An agent needs an escalation contact — who it turns to when it hits a gate.
- An agent's reporting line changes.

ACTIONS:
- link (default): create or reactivate the relationship.
- unlink: end it.

RELATIONS (all expressed from the AGENT's point of view):
- manager: the agent REPORTS TO the target.
- report: the target reports to the agent.
- escalation: the agent ESCALATES TO the target when stuck or blocked.

INPUTS:
- agent_id: the agent being placed (required).
- relation: manager | report | escalation (required).
- target_party_id: the other party — a human or another agent (required). Use
  org_lookup_tool action=find_person to turn a name into a party_id; do not guess ids
  from memory or old messages.
- action: link | unlink. Defaults to link.
- start_at / end_at: optional ISO8601 bounds for the relationship.

RETURNS: the agent's resulting managers, reports and escalation contacts, so you can
confirm the change landed rather than assuming it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_id` | integer | yes | The agent being placed in the org chart. |
| `relation` | string | yes | manager (agent reports to target), report (target reports to agent), or escalation (agent escalates to target). One of: `manager`, `report`, `escalation`. |
| `target_party_id` | integer | yes | Party id of the manager / report / escalation contact (human or agent). |
| `action` | string | no | link (default) or unlink. One of: `link`, `unlink`. |
| `start_at` | string | no | Optional ISO8601 start of the relationship. |
| `end_at` | string | no | Optional ISO8601 end of the relationship. |
